combo_label: Birthdays × Fossil Hunting × 20th-Century English Choral Music

entries.clue: Thump, or the loud do thrown when someone turns forty
Village next to Lyme Regis, its Heritage Coast Centre a hunter's first stop
Ruffed, cassocked child singer earning their keep at daily services
Spiny globe of the seabed, found in chalk as a shepherd's crown
Serrated black triangle on the strandline, shed by an ancient shark
Boy singer's soaring top line, gone once the voice breaks
Early Jurassic blue-grey band of limestone and shale, rich in ammonites
Whitby's black gem, fossilised monkey puzzle wood worn in Victorian mourning
Lyte begged the Lord to do this with him as eventide fell fast
Free travel ticket that comes at sixty in Wales, far later in England
Twenty years, in the old counting, or the tally kept at a match
Praise song announced by number on a board by the pulpit
Daily choral office pairing Magnificat with Nunc Dimittis as the light fails
What are wished, many and happy, when the day comes round again
